question: What should one meditate upon in the eight sūktas and by what power?
premises: The verse directs meditation on the middle-standing element.
It specifies meditation by one's own radiance.
inference: One should meditate on the middle-standing element in the eight sūktas by one's own radiance.
uncertainties: The identity of the middle-standing element is not explicit.
plain_english: Meditate on the middle-standing element in the eight sūktas by your own radiance.
